question: When a FLYNN continuation is restored with physics at the snapshot boundary but other snapshot components left at their post-step values, which components change the first restored action?
parent_finding: authority_replay_v1 fault S1 (seeds 0-2): pose/integration-only restore on the live engine changed the first action; complete restore agreed. That unit does not identify which unrestored component matters.

seed_status: development only; authority_replay_v1 declares no held-out seeds and these seeds were already used by its continuation unit

capture.source: capture at the paused boundary after prefix_ticks live steps
capture.donor: capture at the paused boundary after one further live step from that source boundary (the post-step values S1 leaves in place)
capture.expected: the live engine's tick states for horizon_ticks steps from the source boundary (the donor capture happens between expected ticks 1 and 2 and mutates no scientific state)

invariant_rule: source and donor must agree on invariant_keys (teacher is None for flynn); otherwise the seed is a failed unit

arms.full: every component from source (reference arm; exercised is null)
arms.pose_only: physics from source, every other component from donor
arms.leave_one_out: every component from source except one, taken from donor (7 arms)
arms.add_one_in: pose_only plus one non-physics component from source (6 arms)
arms.add:controller_inputs: pose_only plus observation, controller_hidden and controller_retina from source (1 arm; proposed after AI review because the tick-0 action reads only these three; approved by owner 2026-11-23)

restore_path: each arm restores its hybrid snapshot into a freshly opened engine with Engine.restore_branch (production validation path), then steps horizon_ticks
tick_state: authority_replay_v1.fault_matrix._tick_state (qpos, qvel, control, hidden, action, revision, retinas)

metrics.primary: first_action_divergence_tick: first restored tick (0..horizon_ticks-1) whose action fails the comparison, null if none; first_action_changed means tick 0
secondary: scientific_first_divergence over horizon_ticks (field and tick; revision excluded)
per-tick total_tick and phase; a tick that does not advance ends the arm as runtime_failure

exercised_rule: Per seed and component, record whether source and donor digests differ. An arm is exercised iff any of its tested components (loo:c and add:c -> {c}; add:controller_inputs -> those three; pose_only -> all non-physics) differs. A not_exercised arm is reported but never read as 'component does not matter'. All 16 arms are attempted on every started seed; failed, timed-out and not-started seeds are padded with placeholder rows so rows.jsonl always holds 96 rows.

harness_checks.H1: full arm completes with no scientific and no application divergence over horizon_ticks. Any H1 failure makes every attribution for that seed invalid; reported as a harness failure.
harness_checks.H2: pose_only changes the tick-0 action on seeds 0, 1, 2. This is a consistency check with the parent S1 finding, not an independent validation: it is expected whenever donor observation or controller state differ, and the parent used live mj_setState, not restore_branch.

analysis.necessary_first_action: component c: leave_one_out[c] changes the tick-0 action, given H1
analysis.necessary_horizon: component c: leave_one_out[c] has any scientific divergence within horizon_ticks, given H1
analysis.repairs_first_action: arm add:x repairs pose_only if its tick-0 action is unchanged while pose_only's changed, given H1
analysis.reporting: per-component counts over valid seeds (n<=6); descriptive only, no significance test, no extrapolation beyond FLYNN sparse-navigation on CPU
analysis.interactions: no arms beyond these 16 are added after seeing results

resources.estimate_basis: parent S1 took 39.7 s wall for two engine opens plus 10 steps; this study opens 17 engines per seed and steps 17 x 64 ticks. Torch uses 2 threads, so CPU can exceed wall. The owner-approved smoke run (seed 1000, horizon 2) measures open and restore cost before GO.
resources.cpu_accounting: seed CPU from RUSAGE_CHILDREN per seed child (stop rule); cpu.json also records RUSAGE_SELF+CHILDREN including the parent's runtime copy and identity hashing, which is the figure charged to the lane

stop_rules: Before each seed, stop if used CPU-s plus the largest per-seed CPU-s seen so far (or 900 for the first seed) exceeds study_ceiling_cpu_seconds.
Stop new seeds after any seed timeout.
Retain completed, failed, refused and timed-out rows; never delete, replace, retry or rerun a seed.
No automatic retries. No held-out reads.

prediction_from_code: Recorded before any run, from engine.py advance() for flynn sparse-navigation: the tick-0 action is policy.act on the cached observation (cameras via effective_cameras, which also applies the application's eyes flags; collision/wind sensors) with the current hidden and retina state, computed before env.step; no sparse-navigation branch refreshes the observation first. So leave_one_out arms for physics, environment and rng cannot change the tick-0 action, and application can only through eyes, which a step does not change. Their effects can appear only at later ticks or in non-action fields. No single add_one_in arm is expected to repair pose_only if two or more of observation, hidden and retina differ between source and donor; add:controller_inputs is expected to repair the tick-0 action. The tick-0 part is therefore largely determined by code structure; the informative parts are which of observation, hidden and retina matter alone, and horizon divergence. A result contradicting this is reported as such, not reinterpreted.
hybrid_coherence: Hybrids are validated per component only: restore checks physics as one unit and the application against the destination, but nothing compares application total_tick/episode_step with environment _t or physics time. restore_refused=false therefore means the production restore accepted the hybrid, not that the hybrid is a state the live engine could reach. Arms taking donor application start one tick later; with prefix 8 + horizon 64 + 1 far below the 600-tick episode and the 50-tick stall limit, no arm is expected to terminate.
